mechanics.title: Built-in resource packs
mechanics.description: "Default Connected Textures" (glass, sandstone, bookshelves) and "Glass Pane Culling Fix" (removes faces between vertically stacked panes so they look seamless). Both can be toggled in the resource pack screen.

mechanics.title: Connected/emissive texture support
mechanics.description: Any resource pack using the OptiFine or Continuity connected-textures, emissive-textures (blocks and item models only) or custom-block-layers formats will work.

qol: Glass, sandstone and bookshelves render with seamless connected textures by default.
commands_and_keybinds: Config screen options: Connected Textures, Emissive Textures, Custom Block Layers (each on/off).
getting_started: Nothing to do; enable or disable the built-in packs from Options > Resource Packs.
editor_notes: Compatibility with other rendering mods in the pack is not verified here.
name: Continuity
summary: Client-side mod that lets resource packs use OptiFine-style connected textures, emissive textures and custom block layers without OptiFine. It ships two built-in packs: connected textures for glass, sandstone and bookshelves, and a fix that culls faces between stacked glass panes.
